objective: Establish model and transfer evidence before testing whether hockey-stop imitation improves useful sliding.

hardware.source: User confirmation on 2026-10-31: hardware measurements can be arranged later

ordering: A: policy-independent contact-model and numerical checks
B: matched RL training and cross-backend evaluation
C: held-out real measurement and sim2real gap quantification
D: hockey-stop imitation and useful-sliding ablations

A.next_gate: Extend controlled geometry/law/numerics checks using validated native force vectors; the one-wheel result does not establish full-robot transfer.
independent_factors: collision geometry: cylinder versus sliced approximation, matched outer dimensions and inertia
tangential law: native friction versus external nonlinear tire law
numerics: timestep and solver iterations at fixed model parameters
coupling: external force delay and normal-load source
A.pilot_limit: A lightly loaded, unactuated axle fixture cannot establish full-robot or real-tire accuracy.
A.native_force_gate: Passed: all full cases close momentum; aggregate friction capacity uses scalar native normal loads, not world-Z force.
A.mesh_geometry_gate: Significant triangulation sensitivity observed; keep ground representation explicit in cross-backend studies.

B.existing_outputs: Historical evidence only until source, actor, reward, actuator, dt, DR and reference manifests pass compatibility checks.
fixed_across_algorithms: observable states, privileged critic states and action semantics
reward formulas, weights, termination and evaluation horizon
DR distributions where representable in both backends
training transition budget and held-out evaluation disturbances
B.training_budget_status: Frozen seed42, 512 environments, 12288000 transitions per algorithm/backend; matching PPO seed42 actors reused without retraining. Single-seed descriptive comparison.
B.shared_initial_state_replay: Short action-target replay with actual applied torque recorded; equal targets do not imply equal torque or hidden contact state.
closed_loop_metrics: speed retention or stop time/distance as appropriate

matched_action_replays.direction: PhysX-recorded requests replayed in CPU MuJoCo

algorithm_recipe_differences: SAC fixed identity observation normalization versus PPO online RSL normalization
SAC tanh versus PPO clipped Gaussian actions
Off-policy replay/entropy updates versus PPO on-policy updates
B.reference_task: traj_4 high-speed turn; hockey prior benefit remains a separate later study
B.geometry_contact_reporting: XML collider center and axis included; PhysX envelope remains a proxy, not cooked native geometry equivalence.

optional_force_evidence: motor-current torque estimate with calibration and uncertainty
C.without_force_measurement: Measure contact-conditioned kinematic slip; identify net dynamics. Per-wheel friction-cone saturation remains an estimate, not directly measured ground truth.
separate_data_splits: held-out validation by run and surface condition

D.benefit_test: Improved stopping/turning performance at comparable contact stability and smoothness, with independently measured sliding evidence.
